text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (April 30, 2024) for 2313 Islington Avenue

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed Items 6, 7 and 9 of the Property Standards Order (April 30, 2024) for 2313 Islington Avenue, Folder Number 24 134812 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to August 31, 2024. 2. Confirmed Items 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 8 of the Property Standards Order (April 30, 2024) for 2313 Islington Avenue, Folder Number 24 134812 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to December 31, 2026.
